rules.R0_worlds: PerceivedSurfaceWorld(24, 16, stage45=True) with adapter defaults segmentation=persistence=colour=pooled=looking=True; the param nodes are read back after build and asserted enabled==1 (and pooled==1). One fresh world per sequence (per layout x td x arm; B3: per illuminant x td; B7: per layout x td x Poisson seed).
rules.R1_surface_unit: A 'surface' for per-surface reporting is a declared ground-truth patch (ids 0=background neutral 5, 1..10) of the scene shown at that exposure (label_map, reporting only). Its sid(s) = the set of graph cur_sid over its cells.
rules.R2_neutral_white: B2 'neutral' = background patch 0 (neutral 5; held-out layouts permute only chromatic reflectances, so it is the only neutral); 'white' = patch 1.
rules.R3_exempt: P1 exception set (per B1 sequence): a patch is criterion-boundary iff at some exposure of the sequence some 4-adjacent cell pair (a in the patch, b in a different patch) satisfies |Y_a - Y_b| <= sqrt(Y_a + Y_b), Y = the graph's own seg_Y readout (the segmentation seed's join criterion).
rules.R4_silent_rebind: A silent re-bind = a SurfaceSegment with decision 'continue' at exposure t whose sid covers a different SET of ground-truth patches at t than at t-1. A refused split/merge = the affected cells' segment is a 'birth' (birth_reason recorded).
rules.R5_P1_B1: P1(B1) supported iff every non-exempt patch has one constant sid across all 4 exposures AND there is no silent re-bind in any held-out B1 sequence (both tds). Exempt patches may keep or change sid.
rules.R6_hue: Hue angle = degrees(atan2(by, rg)) of the SurfaceLook of the patch's sid; change = |wrapped difference| in [0, 180] vs exposure 1. A patch enters the hue statistics at exposure t only if at both exposure 1 and t it is covered by exactly one sid, that sid covers no other patch, and the sid has a SurfaceLook.
rules.R7_anchor: Anchor surface of a check frame = the sid(s) whose lattice catch (cL,cM,cS) equals the frame anchor (aL,aM,aS) on all three channels (catch of a sid minted at that epoch = its ColourProperty p). A frame with no such sid, or whose anchor sid was minted at that epoch, counts as rung 1 NOT holding on the anchor in that frame.
rules.R8_P3_frames: P3 frames/conditions are the B1 non-reference exposures (D65, A, E_return) of held-out layouts. Non-anchor rung-1 fractions exclude anchor sids and minted checks. The td comparison pools D65 + A frames (illuminant-change frames) at each td; the A vs D65 comparison is made at each td. 'Rung 2 >= rung 1 in every condition': condition = (layout, td, exposure); count holds vs holds_pooled over non-minted checks.
rules.R9_compare: Fraction comparisons are made on point estimates; Wilson 95% intervals (z=1.95996) are reported alongside. Comparison clauses evaluated at each td separately: true at every td -> supported, at some -> partially, at none -> not supported.
rules.R10_universal: Universal clauses ('every', 'all'): all instances -> supported; at least one but not all -> partially; none -> not supported. A prediction with several clauses is supported iff all clauses are supported, not supported iff all are not supported, otherwise partially.
rules.R11_B3: B3: one fresh world and ONE exposure per (illuminant in E,D65,A) x (td in 1000, 1e4): diffuse(24,16, ill, td, filter='eyelid'), cumulative quantisation.
rules.R12_B4_pair: B4 pair: among declared patches 1..10 whose reflectance is chromatic (name not starting with white/neutral/black -- i.e. excludes patch 1), the pair with the largest |L+M| difference of spectral_scene.patch_report(scene, 'E', td)['lm']; ties -> lexicographically smallest (a, b).
rules.R13_B5_patch: B5 moved patch: the lowest-id declared patch whose rect, translated by every cumulative offset of the schedule (+1..+4 then +10 columns), stays on the 24-column sheet and never overlaps another declared patch's rect (geometry only; identical in every layout). Schedule = spectral_scene.motion steps [(1,0)]*4 + [(6,0)]; exposure 0 unmoved.
rules.R14_B5_verdict: P1(B5) per sequence: the moved patch has one sid at exposures 0..4 equal to its exposure-0 sid; at the jump (exposure 5) it has one sid never seen before in the sequence, whose PersistentSurface born_epoch equals that epoch, and the previous sid has status 'coasting' with coast >= 1.
rules.R15_B6_room: B6 room Mondrian: STANDARD_LAYOUT geometry; slot i (rect order 1..10) gets ColorChecker neutral number 19 + ((i-1) mod 6) (19 white 9.5 ... 24 black 2); background neutral 5. Slots 4 and 10 therefore carry neutral 5 = background (not segmentable from it). Interleaving: the two eyelid ganzfelds split the 6 room exposures into three equal runs: M M G M M G M M. Ganzfeld = diffuse(24,16,'E', td, filter='eyelid'). Release: 3 x render(standard_mondrian(seed=k), 'E', td). All at the arm's scene_td.
rules.R16_B6_verdict: P5 clauses per sequence: (a) node types and edge types with count > 0 after release are a subset of those with count > 0 after the room; (b) every chromatic patch of the release scene is covered at release exposure 1 by one sid that has a ColourProperty minted at a release epoch (evaluated per patch, universal); (c) SurfaceLook count and presents_property edge count both increase during release.
rules.R17_B7: B7: spectral_scene.illuminant_change(scene, [E,D65,A,E], td, method='poisson', seed=s) (per-exposure seed offset +index, per-cell SeedSequence). Segment count = number of SurfaceSegment nodes of that epoch. Clause 1: in every (layout, td, exposure) cell, median over the 5 seeds > deterministic B1 count of the same cell. Clause 2: at each td, rung-1 refusal fraction refused/(holds+refused) over non-minted checks of exposures 2-4 pooled over k=1,2 and seeds >= the same fraction for deterministic B1 on k=1,2.
rules.R18_determinism: After the full battery, B1 and B3 are re-run in fresh worlds; the sha256 of their raw records (timings excluded) must equal the first run's.
rules.R19_dev: The development layout (seed=None) is run in every layout arm and summarised separately; it never enters a verdict.
